title: Are we over-diagnosing everything?

turns.speaker: Ravi
turns.text: Adult referrals have gone up about eightfold in a decade. Somebody at the meeting called it a fashion.

turns.speaker: Elif
turns.text: Which is the word that ends the conversation rather than starting one.

turns.speaker: Susan
turns.text: The rise is real and so is the previous undercount. Both can be true, and mostly people argue as if only one can.

turns.speaker: Susan
turns.text: Girls, overwhelmingly. The diagnostic criteria were built on studies of boys, so a quieter presentation simply didn't register.

turns.speaker: Elif
turns.text: So a lot of what looks like a surge is a backlog of forty-year-olds finally getting an explanation.

turns.speaker: Ravi
turns.text: That's persuasive for the adult figures. It's less obviously true for the children.

turns.speaker: Susan
turns.text: Agreed, and there the threshold question is genuine. The line between a trait and a disorder is drawn by committee and it has moved.

turns.speaker: Elif
turns.text: The functional criterion is meant to hold that, though. It's a disorder if it impairs your life.

turns.speaker: Ravi
turns.text: Which depends on what your life demands. The same person is impaired in one job and fine in another.

turns.speaker: Susan
turns.text: That's the honest complexity. It's partly a fact about a person and partly about the environment they're in.

turns.speaker: Elif
turns.text: The waiting lists are the immediate problem anyway. Five years for an assessment makes the debate academic.

turns.speaker: Ravi
turns.text: And pushes people to private services with an obvious incentive.

points: Adult referrals have risen roughly eightfold in a decade, dismissed by some as fashion.
Susan argues both a genuine rise and a previous undercount can be true simultaneously.
Diagnostic criteria built on studies of boys meant quieter presentations, particularly in girls, went unrecognised.
Elif suggests much of the adult increase reflects a backlog of belated diagnoses.
For children, the threshold between trait and disorder is set by committee and has shifted, with the functional criterion depending on environmental demands.
Five-year waiting lists make the debate academic and push people towards private services with obvious incentives.
